sentence: This project builds a technology that makes drug discovery easier for any gene linked to a disease.
This project studies whether a growth factor helps fat cell progenitors multiply and develop into more fat cells.
This project tests how to offer genomic screening for actionable diseases in primary care.
This project studies how sodium channels affect the sensory behavior of mosquitoes that spread human diseases.
This project develops a biomaterial for dental pulp capping that aims to help compromised pulp heal with less inflammation.
This project develops and tests combined immunotherapy strategies to suppress or remove HIV without antiretroviral therapy.
This project tests whether a mutated human protein can slow chronic kidney disease in rat and minpig models.
This project studies how a nuclear envelope protein affects fertility in mouse models.
This project studies how a genotype that raises Alzheimer's disease risk changes how microglia work and respond to amyloid in mice.
This project builds laser tools that make hyperpolarized xenon-129 gas more efficiently for pulmonary imaging.
This project builds computer algorithms that describe the many ways B cells change in health and disease.
This project uses a two-photon microscope to image the brains of large animals after traumatic brain injury.
This project tests whether ultrasound imaging can find the mechanism of cardiac arrhythmias and guide their treatment.
This project uses artificial intelligence to analyze human brain imaging data and find markers of psychiatric disorders.
This project uses a microplate reader to test thousands of compounds and find drug candidates.
This project develops and tests focused ultrasound to help drugs reach cerebral cavernous malformations.
This project studies whether cancer patients who get federal housing assistance receive timely, guideline-concordant care.
This project provides sample handling and analysis support to study how menopause hormone therapy affects the aging female brain.
This project builds mass spectrometry tools to study membrane protein complexes and the lipid environments around them.
This project builds an imaging tool using magnetic resonance imaging to measure swallowing motions and neural activity together.
